infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SNOWD uses your location to show nearby shovelers and to share your ETA with customers.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SNOWD uses the camera to send photos in chat and to confirm finished jobs.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SNOWD lets you choose photos to send in chat and to confirm finished jobs.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SNOWD uses the microphone to record voice messages in chat.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: SNOWD uses your contacts so you can text friends an invite. Your contacts stay on your phone.
